target.price: exact twice-midpoint nanodollars; strictly future native publications; horizon endpoint inclusive
target.censor: explicit missing label, never a market class or pre-policy filter

model.fit: train only; no refit or hyperparameter search
model.weight: inverse multiplicity per decision clock, equal total weight per day, rescaled to mean one
model.preprocess: train medians, missing indicators, train weighted means/scales; transformed values clipped to [-8,8]
model.time_bin_model: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; bins retained for audit, primary model is conditional 300-second categorical probability on known outcomes

mbo.global: all22day canonical cumulative flows and book snapshots; departure and decision windows
mbo.local: seven existing price-local sidecar days, descriptive only; no training prefix exists
mbo.missing: unknown with explicit mask; no zero fill for absent or unsupported source

placebo.rule: strictly prior different absolute price-zone memory in same coarse context; latest donor from256-row stratum reservoir
placebo.interpretation: causal stale-other-zone control, not a randomized causal test

policy.clock: common nearest eligible zone per timestamp chosen before model score
policy.score: P(RETURN_FIRST), geometric success probability and not expected dollars
policy.threshold: calibration scores only, no labels; score >= frozen threshold; no future daily quota
policy.execution: reuse hash-verified source 300s outcomes, unchanged targets/stops/fees/latency and one-position account
policy.random_control: deterministic Bernoulli by candidate ID; fixed context-stratum calibration acceptance probability (accepted+10*global_rate)/(n+10), global fallback for unseen strata; approximate context matching, no future count matching
policy.WAIT: retained zero account; unresolved positions halt and invalidate complete-capital claim

evaluation.bootstrap: paired daily losses, 2000 resamples, descriptive95percentile interval
evaluation.economic: net, stress net, matched-activity random and away-direction controls reported separately
evaluation.admission: No production admission from previously inspected dates; incremental diagnostic support requires lower logloss and Brier in both later blocks. Capital evidence additionally requires positive complete base/stress and beating random95 with >=30 trades and >=4 active days.

scope: Frozen hypothesis before fitting; comparable candidates and source data. No reward shaping, martingale, threshold search or replacement of negative previous experiments. All dates have previously been inspected.
